transformations: Compute interior label anchors and sampled boundary clearance from merged 50m country polygons
Retain only anchors contained by both 50m and 110m geometries when both are present
Round coordinates and clearance to six decimal places for deterministic static delivery
missingValuePolicy: Countries without a cross-resolution anchor use the runtime 110m geometry algorithm or an explicit verified fallback.
boundaryPolicy: Natural Earth boundaries are cartographic data and are not a legal authority on territorial status.
